html:
For Campuses, Offices & NGOs

Doptor ERP

One platform, three dedicated modules: Campus, Office and NGO management

Why management matters

Every organisation runs on admin. It shouldn't run on chasing it.

Behind every class taught, every file approved and every village reached is a long trail of admin: attendance, approvals, budgets, records and reports. When that trail lives in registers, spreadsheets and inboxes, people spend their days looking for information instead of using it.

  • ScatteredInformation split across registers, sheets and chat groups.
  • RepeatedThe same details typed again for every form and report.
  • RushedReports pieced together at the last minute, from memory.

Doptor ERP keeps it all in one place: entered once, used everywhere, so the work that matters gets the time it deserves.

Doptor ERP

Pick the module built for how you work, campus administration, office operations or NGO impact tracking, all inside one platform.

Campus Manager

Admissions, departments, faculty, student records, examinations and results, all from one campus workspace.

Office Manager

A simple hub for daily admin: centralised operations, shared task views and real-time oversight for your team.

NGO Manager

Track projects, teams, funds and field activities from one impact dashboard.

Three spaces, one platform

Management made easier, wherever you work

An office, a college and an NGO look very different from the outside. Inside, they wrestle with the same thing: too much admin, spread across too many places.

In the office

Less chasing, more doing

The challenge

Office work is a web of small tasks: leave requests, approvals, files, purchases, meetings and follow-ups. Each one is simple. Together they swallow the day, and when one person is away, nobody knows where things stand.

With Doptor ERP

  • Tasks, approvals and files in one shared place
  • Attendance, leave and staff records kept up to date
  • Clear owners, so nothing waits on a missing reply
  • A live view of workloads and progress for managers
Explore Office Manager

In colleges and academic spaces

More time for teaching and learning

The challenge

A campus runs on thousands of moving parts: admissions, timetables, attendance, fees, exams and results, across departments that often keep their own records. Teachers end up doing data entry, and students wait days for answers that should take a minute.

With Doptor ERP

  • One record for every student, from admission onwards
  • Attendance, timetables and fees without duplicate registers
  • Exams planned, results recorded and published in one flow
  • Academic analytics for principals, heads and faculty
Explore Campus Manager

In the NGO space

Impact you can show, not just claim

The challenge

NGOs work across many projects, places and donors, each with its own budget, indicators and reporting format. Field data arrives on paper, phones and spreadsheets, and turning it into evaluation reports takes weeks of compiling.

With Doptor ERP

  • Projects, teams and field activities tracked by location
  • Funds and spending traced back to every grant
  • Beneficiary and survey data collected once, in the field
  • Evaluation reports built from the data you already have
Explore NGO Manager

For schools and colleges

The everyday running of a campus, in one place

Doptor already runs the day-to-day work of teams: tasks, weekly plans, attendance, leave and notes. On a campus, the same tools take the load off principals, heads of department and teachers.

Staff attendance

Teachers and staff check in and out with one tap. Times come from the server, so they cannot be changed afterwards.

Leave for faculty

Apply for leave, see the balance and get a decision. Holidays and weekends are left out of the count, and heads see who is away before planning cover.

Weekly teaching plan

Each department's week from Monday to Friday: classes, unit tests and duties, and what is still waiting from last week.

Tasks with owners

Question papers, evaluation, events and accreditation work, each with an owner, a reviewer and a due date.

Department chat

A conversation for every department or class, with threads, file attachments and links in one place.

Wiki for syllabus and notes

Syllabus, lesson notes and question banks kept by department, with the earlier versions of each note saved.

Three access layers

Everyone sees what they need

Principal

Runs the institution: people, departments, leave types, holidays and working hours.

Head of department

Runs the department: all its plans and reports, and approves leave and attendance corrections.

Teachers and staff

Do the work: their classes and tasks, the weekly plan, the Wiki, and their own attendance and leave.

Evaluation and reporting

Evaluation reports, without the scramble

An NGO is asked to report all the time: to donors, boards, government departments and its own teams. Each report wants the same facts in a different shape. Doptor keeps every activity, beneficiary, rupee and indicator in one place, so a report becomes a matter of choosing what to include, not weeks of gathering it.

Donor and grant reports

Progress, spending and outcomes for each grant, in the format each funder asks for.

Monitoring and evaluation

Indicators tracked against your logframe or results framework, project by project.

Baseline, midline and endline

Survey rounds compared side by side, to show what changed and where.

Field and activity reports

Visits, trainings and distributions logged from the field, with photos and locations.

Fund utilisation

Budget against actual spend for every project, ready for utilisation certificates and audits.

Board and annual reports

Organisation-wide numbers and stories, brought together for the year.

Because every report draws on the same records, the numbers match across all of them.
